[[Anarchic Burst#Anarchic Burst|Anarchic Burst 7]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Anarchic Burst#Anarchic Burst|Anarchic Burst 7]]:''' This weapon is a chaotic conduit, dealing 7d6 Chaos damage on a successful hit to Lawful enemies, and 16d6 Chaos damage on a critical hit to Lawful enemies. This effect makes the weapon chaotically aligned.
Lawful characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.
